Combine levels

Source: R/rbin-factor.R
rbin_factor_combine.Rd

Manually combine levels of categorical data.

Usage

rbin_factor_combine(data, var, new_var, new_name)

Arguments

data

A data.frame or tibble.

var

Bare or character name of a factor or character column in data.

new_var

A character vector containing the names of levels to combine. An NA selects both an explicit NA level and missing factor codes.

new_name

Name of the combined level.

Value

A data.frame with the predictor's levels combined. The predictor keeps its original position among the columns.

Details

Levels are matched exactly, not as regular expressions. Only the selected levels are renamed; other levels are left untouched even when their names contain the selected name as a substring. Unselected explicit NA levels and missing codes are preserved, as is the ordered class. A combined level takes the position of its first selected level; a new level for missing codes alone is appended at the end.

Examples

upper <- c("secondary", "tertiary")
out <- rbin_factor_combine(mbank, education, upper, "upper")
table(out$education)
#> 
#>   upper unknown primary 
#>    3651     179     691 

out <- rbin_factor_combine(mbank, education, c("secondary", "tertiary"), "upper")
table(out$education)
#> 
#>   upper unknown primary 
#>    3651     179     691
